---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Welcome to Undertale: The Timelines Randomized Codes!
Another Undertale game where you can fight or roleplay with other players!
Unlock and play as a whole variety of characters, most of them original creations (OCs) made by the owner and his friends, each with their own unique style and abilities. 
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
How CODE Works: You can earn CODES to upgrade your character in multiple ways:
Staying in the game, participating in admin-hosted event and other special opportunities that may appear.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
What You Can Do:
Fight other players, roleplay and discover new characters and abilities
Please follow the game rules and respect others.... no need for mass bans, right?
